correctness.rationale: PASS. Every primitive vertex is an orientation of one of five graph edges, and a simplex is a compatible acyclic partial orientation. The complete face enumeration gives f=(10,33,40,15) and 98 nonempty faces. An independently coded Hasse-poset enumeration produced 246 covers and a 48-pair acyclic discrete-Morse matching, leaving exactly one critical 0-cell and one critical 2-cell; the oriented matching directed graph was independently verified acyclic. By the full discrete Morse collapsing theorem, this yields a CW complex with one 0-cell and one 2-cell, attaching boundary to a point, hence S^2. Numerical Betti checks alone would not establish homotopy.
